caption: The drawing features a single object placed centrally on a plain, untextured background. The object is a dark-colored, metallic-looking stand composed of three main sections: a flat, irregularly shaped base with an open center, two curved supports that rise from the base and converge towards the middle, and a slender, upright central stem that extends vertically from the convergence point of the supports. The stem terminates in a slightly flared, cylindrical cup at the top. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray using pencil or similar medium, with careful shading to suggest texture and depth, but no additional colors are present beyond the grayscale tones. The background is left blank, directing all attention to the form and construction of the stand itself.
title: Candle Holder
